claims.quote: with leathery skin and froglike faces. In other versions of the story, they were spotted either on top of or beneath a poorly lit bridge, with one holding a wand overhead that fired a spray of sparks.

claims.statement: Loveland police officer Ray Shockey was driving on Riverside Drive near the Little Miami River when an unidentified animal ran across the road in front of him.
claims.statement_id: Polisi Loveland Ray Shockey sedang berkendara di Riverside Drive dekat Sungai Little Miami ketika seekor hewan tak dikenal melintas di depan mobilnya.
claims.quote: Loveland police officer Ray Shockey was driving on Riverside Drive near the Totes boot factory and the Little Miami River when an unidentified animal scurried across the road in front of his vehicle.

claims.statement: He reported that the animal crouched like a frog, then briefly stood upright to climb the guardrail and go back down to the river.
claims.statement_id: Ia melaporkan hewan itu berjongkok seperti katak lalu sempat berdiri tegak untuk memanjat pagar pembatas dan turun ke sungai.
claims.quote: He reported that the animal "crouched like a frog" before it momentarily stood erect to climb over the guardrail and back down towards the river.

claims.statement: Two weeks later a second Loveland officer, Mark Matthews, saw an unidentified animal crouching by the road in the same area.
claims.statement_id: Dua minggu kemudian, polisi Loveland kedua, Mark Matthews, melihat hewan tak dikenal berjongkok di tepi jalan di sekitar lokasi yang sama.
claims.quote: Two weeks after the incident, a second Loveland police officer, Mark Matthews, reported seeing an unidentified animal crouched along the road in the same vicinity as the first officer's sighting.

claims.statement: According to Matthews, Shockey was shown the dead iguana and confirmed it was the animal he had seen two weeks earlier.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Matthews, Shockey ditunjukkan iguana mati itu dan membenarkan bahwa itulah hewan yang dilihatnya dua minggu sebelumnya.
claims.quote: According to Matthews, Shockey was shown the dead iguana and confirmed it was the animal he had seen two weeks prior.

claims.statement: Matthews speculated the iguana was a pet that escaped or was released when it grew too large.
claims.statement_id: Matthews menduga iguana itu hewan peliharaan yang lepas atau dilepas karena tumbuh terlalu besar.
claims.quote: Matthews speculated that the iguana had been someone's pet that "either got loose or was released when it grew too large".

claims.statement: In May 2014 the legend was turned into a musical titled Hot Damn! It's the Loveland Frog!
claims.statement_id: Pada Mei 2014 legenda ini diangkat menjadi drama musikal berjudul Hot Damn! It's the Loveland Frog!
claims.quote: 2014年5月，拉夫兰青蛙人的传说被制作成音乐剧，名为《Hot Damn! It’s the Loveland Frog!》。

claims.statement: In Canadian folklore, Manipogo is a lake monster said to live in Lake Manitoba, Canada.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kanada, Manipogo adalah monster danau yang konon hidup di Danau Manitoba, Kanada.
claims.quote: In Canadian folklore, the Manipogo is a lake monster said to live in Lake Manitoba, Manitoba, Canada.

claims.statement: The creature was named Manipogo in 1960, echoing British Columbia's Ogopogo.
claims.statement_id: Nama Manipogo diberikan pada 1960 dengan meniru nama Ogopogo dari British Columbia.
claims.quote: The creature was dubbed Manipogo in 1960, the name echoing British Columbia's Ogopogo.

claims.statement: Manipogo Provincial Park is named after it.
claims.statement_id: Taman Provinsi Manipogo dinamai menurut makhluk ini.
claims.quote: It is the namesake of the Manipogo Provincial Park.

claims.statement: The community of St. Laurent on Lake Manitoba's southeast shore holds a Manipogo Festival every first week of March.
claims.statement_id: Komunitas St. Laurent di tepi tenggara Danau Manitoba mengadakan Festival Manipogo setiap minggu pertama bulan Maret.
claims.quote: The community of St. Laurent on the southeast shore of Lake Manitoba holds a yearly Manipogo Festival during the first week of March.

claims.statement: It is described as having a brownish-black body with at least one hump showing above the water.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan bertubuh cokelat kehitaman dengan sedikitnya satu punuk yang tampak di atas air.
claims.quote: It is described as having "a brownish-black body and at least one hump that shows above the water."

claims.statement: Its head is likened to a horse's, camel's or sheep's, while others say it is flat and diamond-shaped.
claims.statement_id: Kepalanya kadang disamakan dengan kepala kuda, unta, atau domba; ada pula yang menyebutnya pipih dan berbentuk belah ketupat.
claims.quote: Its head is sometimes compared to that of a horse, camel, or sheep, while others have claimed it was flat and diamond-shaped.

claims.statement: It reportedly shrieks or cries as it surfaces.
claims.statement_id: Ia konon mengeluarkan jeritan saat muncul ke permukaan.
claims.quote: It is purported to let out a shriek or cry as it surfaces

claims.statement: Local First Nations people have legends of serpent-like creatures in Lake Manitoba going back hundreds of years.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk First Nations setempat punya legenda tentang makhluk mirip ular di Danau Manitoba sejak ratusan tahun lalu.
claims.quote: The local First Nations population has legends of serpent-like creatures in Lake Manitoba going back hundreds of years.

claims.statement: The first documented sighting by a white settler was in September 1909, when Hudson's Bay Company fur trader Valentine McKay claimed to see a huge creature.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan pertama yang terdokumentasi oleh pemukim kulit putih terjadi pada September 1909, ketika pedagang bulu Valentine McKay dari Hudson's Bay Company mengaku melihat makhluk besar.
claims.quote: The first documented sighting by a white settler came in September 1909, when Hudson's Bay Company fur trader Valentine McKay claimed to see a huge creature in Cedar Lake near Graves Point on Lake Manitoba.

claims.statement: Some sceptics think the monster is a swimming moose with its head and humped back showing.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian skeptis menduga monster itu sebenarnya rusa moose yang berenang dengan kepala dan punggung bungkuknya terlihat.
claims.quote: Other sceptics believe that the so-called monster is actually a swimming moose with its head above the surface and its humped back showing as well.

claims.statement: In 1936 fisherman Oscar Fredrickson found an animal skull in his fishing net.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1936 nelayan Oscar Fredrickson menemukan sebuah tengkorak hewan di jaring ikannya.
claims.quote: 1936年：渔民奥斯卡·弗雷德里克森（Oscar Fredrickson）在拉起一网鱼的时候，发现在网里捞起了一块动物的头盖骨。

claims.statement: Soon after, Fredrickson's house burned down for unknown reasons and the skull was lost.
claims.statement_id: Tak lama kemudian rumah Fredrickson terbakar tanpa sebab yang jelas, dan tengkorak itu hilang.
claims.quote: 但不久后弗雷德里克森家发生不明原因的火灾，把整个家都烧毁了，而那块从马尼托巴湖捞起的头盖骨也下落不明。

claims.statement: Local indigenous people also have legends of a water monster; according to this source, the creature was named Manipogo in 1957, echoing British Columbia's Ogopogo.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk asli setempat juga punya legenda monster air; menurut sumber ini, makhluk itu dinamai Manipogo pada 1957 dengan meniru Ogopogo dari British Columbia.
claims.quote: 当地的土著居民也有水怪的传说。这种生物在1957年被命名为马尼波戈，以响应不列颠哥伦比亚省发现的欧戈波戈。

claims.statement: The Patasola, or "single leg", is a Colombian folk legend of a female jungle monster who appears to hunters or loggers in the wilderness when they think about women.
claims.statement_id: Patasola atau "satu kaki" adalah legenda cerita rakyat Kolombia tentang monster perempuan hutan yang mendatangi pemburu atau penebang kayu di tengah belantara bila mereka memikirkan perempuan.
claims.quote: The Patasola or "single leg" is one of many legends in Colombian folklore about female monster from jungle, appearing to male hunters or loggers in the middle of the wilderness if they think about women.

claims.statement: The Patasola appears as a beautiful, seductive woman, often like a loved one, and lures a man away from his companions into the jungle.
claims.statement_id: Patasola muncul sebagai perempuan cantik yang menggoda, sering menyerupai orang terkasih, lalu memikat seorang pria menjauh dari rekan-rekannya ke dalam hutan.
claims.quote: The Patasola appears in the form of a beautiful seductive woman, often in the likeness of a loved one, who lures a man away from his companions, deep into jungle.

claims.statement: There it reveals its true, hideous form: a one-legged creature with a vampire-like lust for human flesh and blood.
claims.statement_id: Di sana ia menampakkan wujud aslinya yang mengerikan: makhluk berkaki satu yang haus daging dan darah manusia seperti vampir.
claims.quote: There, the Patasola reveals it's true, hideous appearance as a one-legged creature with ferocious vampire-like lust for human flesh and blood

claims.statement: Popular belief places it in mountain ranges, virgin forests and other densely wooded areas.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat, ia menghuni pegunungan, hutan perawan, dan kawasan berhutan lebat.
claims.quote: According to popular belief, it inhabits mountain ranges, virgin forests, and other heavily wooded or jungle-like areas.

claims.statement: The Patasola is usually seen as a protector of nature and forest animals, unforgiving toward people who enter to damage them.
claims.statement_id: Patasola biasanya dianggap pelindung alam dan satwa hutan, dan tidak mengampuni manusia yang masuk untuk merusaknya.
claims.quote: The patasola is usually regarded as protective of nature and the forest animals and unforgiving when humans enter their domain to alter or destroy them.

claims.statement: Her single leg ends in a cloven, cow-like hoof.
claims.statement_id: Kaki tunggalnya berakhir dengan kuku belah seperti kuku sapi.
claims.quote: is her one leg which terminates in a cleaved bovine-like hoof

claims.statement: She is also believed to turn into other animals, such as a large black dog or a cow.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga dipercaya dapat berubah menjadi hewan lain, seperti anjing hitam besar atau sapi.
claims.quote: It is also believed that she can transform into other animals, materializing as a large black dog or cow.

claims.statement: Some believe she was a mother who killed her own son and was banished to the woods as punishment.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang percaya ia dulunya seorang ibu yang membunuh anaknya lalu dibuang ke hutan sebagai hukuman.
claims.quote: Some believe that she was a mother who killed her own son and was then banished to the woods as punishment.

claims.statement: Others say she was a cruel temptress whose leg was chopped off with an axe and thrown into a fire.
claims.statement_id: Versi lain menyebut ia penggoda kejam yang kakinya dipotong dengan kapak lalu dilempar ke api.
claims.quote: Others believe that she was a wicked temptress who was cruel to both men and women and for this reason they mutilated her with an axe, chopping off one leg and throwing it into a fire.

claims.statement: According to legend, she is the tormented soul of an unfaithful woman who dishonoured her husband.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, ia arwah penasaran seorang perempuan tidak setia yang mempermalukan suaminya.
claims.quote: Según la leyenda, es el alma en pena de una mujer infiel que deshonró a su marido

claims.statement: A Tzitzimitl is a type of celestial deity linked to the stars in Aztec mythology.
claims.statement_id: Tzitzimitl adalah jenis dewa langit yang dikaitkan dengan bintang dalam mitologi Aztek.
claims.quote: is a type of celestial deity associated with stars in Aztec mythology.

claims.statement: They were shown as skeletal female figures wearing skirts, often with skull-and-crossbones designs.
claims.statement_id: Mereka digambarkan sebagai sosok perempuan berwujud kerangka yang memakai rok, sering bermotif tengkorak dan tulang bersilang.
claims.quote: They were depicted as skeletal female figures wearing skirts often with skull and crossbones designs.

claims.statement: Post-conquest accounts often call them demons or devils, but this does not necessarily reflect their role.
claims.statement_id: Uraian pascapenaklukan sering menyebut mereka iblis atau setan, tetapi sebutan itu belum tentu mencerminkan fungsi mereka.
claims.quote: In post-conquest descriptions they are often described as "demons" or "devils", but this does not necessarily reflect their function

claims.statement: The Tzitzimimeh were female deities related to fertility.
claims.statement_id: Tzitzimimeh adalah dewi-dewi yang berhubungan dengan kesuburan.
claims.quote: The Tzitzimimeh were female deities and related to fertility.

claims.statement: They were worshipped by midwives and women in childbirth.
claims.statement_id: Mereka dipuja oleh bidan dan perempuan yang akan melahirkan.
claims.quote: they were worshipped by midwives and parturient women

claims.statement: Their leader was the goddess Itzpapalotl, ruler of Tamoanchan, the paradise where the Tzitzimimeh lived.
claims.statement_id: Pemimpin mereka adalah dewi Itzpapalotl, penguasa Tamoanchan, surga tempat Tzitzimimeh tinggal.
claims.quote: The leader of the tzitzimimeh was the goddess Itzpapalotl, who was the ruler of Tamoanchan, the paradise where the Tzitzimimeh resided.

claims.statement: Stars seen during an eclipse were read as the Tzitzimimeh attacking the Sun, leading to the belief that they descended to earth and possessed people.
claims.statement_id: Bintang yang tampak saat gerhana ditafsirkan sebagai Tzitzimimeh yang menyerang Matahari, sehingga dipercaya mereka turun ke bumi dan merasuki manusia.
claims.quote: This was interpreted as the Tzitzimimeh attacking the Sun, thus causing the belief that during a solar eclipse, the tzitzimime would descend to the earth and possess men.

claims.statement: It was said that if fire could not be kindled in a sacrificed person's chest at the end of a 52-year calendar round, the fifth sun would end and they would descend to devour the last people.
claims.statement_id: Konon, bila api tidak bisa dinyalakan di rongga dada korban persembahan pada akhir siklus kalender 52 tahun, matahari kelima akan berakhir dan mereka turun untuk memangsa manusia terakhir.
claims.quote: It was said that if the Aztecs could not start a bow fire in the empty chest cavity of a sacrificed human at the end of a 52-year calendar round, the fifth sun would end and they would descend to devour the last of men.

claims.statement: The Tzitzimimeh were also feared in other ominous periods, such as the five unlucky days called Nemontemi.
claims.statement_id: Tzitzimimeh juga ditakuti pada masa-masa buruk lain, seperti lima hari sial yang disebut Nemontemi.
claims.quote: The Tzitzimimeh were also feared during other ominous periods of the Aztec world, such as during the five unlucky days called Nemontemi

claims.statement: The Tzitzimimeh had a double role: protectors of women and ancestresses of humankind.
claims.statement_id: Tzitzimimeh berperan ganda: pelindung kaum perempuan sekaligus leluhur umat manusia.
claims.quote: The Tzitzimimeh had a double role in Aztec religion: they were protectresses of the feminine and progenitresses of mankind.

claims.statement: Tzitzimitl was one of 8 monsters appearing as antagonists in the Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! episode Mysteries On The Disorient Express.
claims.statement_id: Tzitzimitl termasuk 8 monster yang menjadi lawan dalam episode Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! berjudul Mysteries On The Disorient Express.
claims.quote: Tzitzimitl was one of 8 monsters from around the globe to appear as antagonists in the Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! episode titled "Mysteries On The Disorient Express."

claims.statement: The Tzitzimime are generally thought of as female; in the Codex Magliabechiano they appear as skeletons wearing skirts edged with shells.
claims.statement_id: Tzitzimime umumnya dianggap perempuan; dalam Codex Magliabechiano mereka digambarkan sebagai kerangka yang memakai rok berhias kerang.
claims.quote: しかし、ツィツィミメは一般的に女性と考えられている。『マリアベッキアーノ絵文書』のツィツィミメは骸骨の姿をして貝殻の縁取りのスカートを身につけている。

claims.statement: Among Quechua speakers of southern Peru, Apu or Wamani is the name for the mountain deities, still widely revered today.
claims.statement_id: Di kalangan penutur Quechua di Peru selatan, Apu atau Wamani adalah sebutan bagi dewa-dewa gunung yang hingga kini dipuja luas.
claims.quote: Apu oder Wamani ist bei der Quechua-Bevölkerung im südlichen Peru die Bezeichnung für die Berggottheiten, die bis heute weithin Verehrung genießen.

claims.statement: Apu are thought the most powerful nature spirits, may be male or female, and vary in character, some protective and some malicious.
claims.statement_id: Apu dianggap roh alam paling kuat, bisa laki-laki atau perempuan, dan wataknya beragam: ada yang melindungi, ada yang jahat.
claims.quote: Apu are considered the most powerful of nature spirits, can be considered either masculine or feminine, and have varying personalities, with some being protectors and others being malicious.

claims.statement: Apu are most active in August and can have romantic and family ties with one another.
claims.statement_id: Apu paling aktif pada bulan Agustus, dan antar-apu bisa memiliki hubungan asmara maupun keluarga.
claims.quote: Apu are the most active in the month of August and apu can have romantic and familial ties with each other.

claims.statement: Apu are often linked with condors and seen as ancestors.
claims.statement_id: Apu sering dikaitkan dengan burung kondor dan kerap dipandang sebagai leluhur.
claims.quote: Apu are frequently associated with condors and are often seen as ancestors.

claims.statement: In Quechua, apu means "Lord" as well as sacred mountain or mountain deity.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Quechua, apu berarti "Tuan", juga gunung suci atau dewa gunung.
claims.quote: Apu means "Lord" in Quechua as well as sacred mountain or mountain deity.

claims.statement: Apu is the usual name for mountain spirits around Cuzco; they are called awkillu in Huanuco, wamani in Ayacucho, and machula, achachila or mallku in parts of Bolivia.
claims.statement_id: Apu adalah nama paling umum untuk roh gunung di wilayah Cuzco; di Huanuco disebut awkillu, di Ayacucho wamani, dan di Bolivia machula, achachila, atau mallku.
claims.quote: Apu is the most common name for mountain spirits in the Cuzco region of Peru, while they are usually called awkillu in Huanuco, wamani in Ayacucho, and machula, achachila, or mallku in different regions in Bolivia.

claims.statement: The veneration of mountain peaks may date back to the Initial Period of the pre-Hispanic Andes, 2000 to 900 BCE.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan puncak gunung mungkin bermula pada Periode Awal Andes pra-Hispanik, tahun 2000 hingga 900 SM.
claims.quote: The veneration of mountain peaks possibly dates back to the Initial Period of the pre-hispanic Andes, which took place from 2000 to 900 BCE.

claims.statement: Apu Campana was worshipped and appeased with human sacrifices and offerings of food and drink by the Moche, Chimu and Inca empires.
claims.statement_id: Apu Campana dipuja dan ditenangkan dengan pengorbanan manusia serta persembahan makanan dan minuman oleh Kekaisaran Moche, Chimu, dan Inka.
claims.quote: Apu Campana was worshipped and appeased via human sacrifices and through the offerings of food and beverages, by the Moche, Chimu, and Incan Empires.

claims.statement: In the Wiraquchapampa myth told in the Quechua village of Q'ero, the united apus defeat a Spanish army and save the last surviving Inca.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitos Wiraquchapampa dari desa Quechua Q'ero, para apu bersatu mengalahkan pasukan Spanyol dan menyelamatkan segelintir Inka yang tersisa.
claims.quote: Im Mythos von Wiraquchapampa, erzählt im Quechua-Dorf Q'ero, besiegen die vereinten Apus eine spanische Armee und retten so die letzten wenigen überlebenden Inka

claims.statement: Some large mountains, such as Apu Awsanqati in Peru and Apu Illimani in Bolivia, are revered across wide areas as protective deities, alongside the goddess Pachamama.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa gunung besar, seperti Apu Awsanqati di Peru dan Apu Illimani di Bolivia, dipuja di wilayah luas sebagai dewa pelindung, di samping dewi Pachamama.
claims.quote: Einige größere Berge, darunter z. B. der Apu Awsanqati (Ausangate) in Peru oder der Apu Illimani in Bolivien, werden – neben der panandinen Gottheit Pachamama – über größere Gebiete hinweg verehrt, für welche sie eine Schutzgottheit darstellen.

claims.statement: A lutin is a kind of hobgoblin (an amusing goblin) in French folklore and fairy tales.
claims.statement_id: Lutin adalah sejenis hobgoblin (goblin jenaka) dalam cerita rakyat dan dongeng Prancis.
claims.quote: is a type of hobgoblin (an amusing goblin) in French folklore and fairy tales.

claims.statement: In Norman folklore it plays a role like the household spirits of England, Germany and Scandinavia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Normandia, perannya mirip roh rumah tangga di Inggris, Jerman, dan Skandinavia.
claims.quote: plays a similar role in the folklore of Normandy to household spirits in England, Germany and Scandinavia.

claims.statement: It sometimes appears as a saddled horse ready to ride, and in this form is called Le Cheval Bayard.
claims.statement_id: Kadang ia berwujud kuda berpelana siap ditunggangi, dan dalam wujud ini disebut Le Cheval Bayard.
claims.quote: It sometimes takes the form of a horse saddled ready to ride, and in this shape is called Le Cheval Bayard.

claims.statement: Lutins sometimes tangle the hair of people or horses into elf-locks.
claims.statement_id: Lutin kadang menjalin rambut orang atau kuda menjadi kusut.
claims.quote: Lutins sometimes tangle people's or horses' hair into elf-locks.

claims.statement: The French fairy tale Le Prince Lutin was written in 1697 by Marie Catherine d'Aulnoy.
claims.statement_id: Dongeng Prancis Le Prince Lutin ditulis Marie Catherine d'Aulnoy pada 1697.
claims.quote: A French fairy tale, "Le Prince Lutin", written in 1697 by Marie Catherine d'Aulnoy

claims.statement: In that tale the lutin can become invisible at will, cross the universe in a moment and rise without wings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam dongeng itu, lutin dapat menjadi tak terlihat sesuka hati, melintasi alam semesta dalam sekejap, dan naik tanpa sayap.
claims.quote: You are invisible when you like it; you cross in one moment the vast space of the universe; you rise without having wings

claims.statement: The name is attested as netun around 1176–1181 by Chrétien de Troyes in Yvain, the Knight of the Lion.
claims.statement_id: Nama ini tercatat sebagai netun sekitar 1176–1181 dalam karya Chrétien de Troyes, Yvain, the Knight of the Lion.
claims.quote: The name is attested as netun c. 1176–1181 by Chrétien de Troyes in Yvain, the Knight of the Lion

claims.statement: It comes from Latin Neptunus, the Roman sea god's name, which in Late Latin also came to mean a pagan god.
claims.statement_id: Kata ini berasal dari bahasa Latin Neptunus, nama dewa laut Romawi, yang dalam bahasa Latin akhir juga berarti dewa pagan.
claims.quote: It comes from Latin Neptunus, the name of the Roman god of the seas, which came to also designate a pagan god in Late Latin.

claims.statement: Belief in lutins spread to North America, especially Quebec in Canada, as spirits in the form of pets or other common animals.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan pada lutin menyebar ke Amerika Utara, terutama Quebec, Kanada, sebagai roh berwujud hewan peliharaan atau hewan biasa.
claims.quote: Belief in lutins also spread to North America, particularly the Canadian province of Quebec, as spirits in the form of either pets (such as dogs or rabbits) or other common animals.

claims.statement: Completely white cats are especially thought likely to be lutins.
claims.statement_id: Kucing yang seluruhnya putih terutama dianggap mungkin lutin.
claims.quote: Completely white cats are especially considered likely to be lutins

claims.statement: The lutin is a small nocturnal humanoid from the folklore of French regions such as Berry, Normandy and Picardy.
claims.statement_id: Lutin adalah makhluk mirip manusia bertubuh kecil yang aktif di malam hari, berasal dari cerita rakyat daerah Prancis seperti Berry, Normandia, dan Picardie.
claims.quote: Le lutin est une créature humanoïde nocturne de petite taille, issue au sens strict du folklore et des croyances populaires de certaines régions françaises comme le Berry, la Normandie et la Picardie.

claims.statement: The Ardennes and Wallonia know a very similar household spirit called the nuton.
claims.statement_id: Di Ardennes dan Wallonia dikenal roh rumah yang sangat mirip bernama nuton.
claims.quote: Les Ardennes et la Wallonie connaissent un génie domestique très proche sous le nom de nuton.

claims.statement: In the mythology of the Andean civilizations of South America, the amaru or katari (Aymara) is a mythical serpent or dragon.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi peradaban Andes di Amerika Selatan, amaru atau katari (Aymara) adalah ular atau naga mitos.
claims.quote: In the mythology of the Andean civilizations of South America, the amaru or katari (Aymara) is a mythical serpent or dragon.

claims.statement: In Inca mythology Amaru is a huge two-headed serpent living underground, at the bottom of lakes and rivers.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Inka, Amaru adalah ular raksasa berkepala dua yang tinggal di bawah tanah, di dasar danau dan sungai.
claims.quote: In Inca mythology, Amaru is a huge double-headed serpent that dwells underground, at the bottom of lakes and rivers.

claims.statement: It stands for infinity, knowledge and cosmic renewal and links the earthly world with the spiritual.
claims.statement_id: Amaru melambangkan ketakterbatasan, pengetahuan, dan pembaruan kosmis, serta menghubungkan dunia fana dengan dunia roh.
claims.quote: It represents infinity, knowledge, and cosmic renewal, and connects the earthly world with the spiritual.

claims.statement: Amaru with the heads of a bird and a puma appears on a stepped-mountain motif on the Gateway of the Sun at Tiwanaku, Bolivia.
claims.statement_id: Amaru berkepala burung dan puma tampak pada motif gunung berundak di Gerbang Matahari Tiwanaku, Bolivia.
claims.quote: Illustrated with the heads of a bird and a puma, Amaru can be seen emerging from a central element in the center of a stepped mountain or pyramid motif in the Gateway of the Sun at Tiwanaku, Bolivia.

claims.statement: On religious vessels amaru is often shown with bird-like feet and wings, so it resembles a dragon.
claims.statement_id: Pada bejana ritual, amaru sering digambarkan berkaki dan bersayap seperti burung sehingga mirip naga.
claims.quote: When illustrated on religious vessels, amaru is often seen with bird-like feet and wings, so that it resembles a dragon.

claims.statement: Amaru was also linked with the waters that irrigated the fields on which the Aymara depended.
claims.statement_id: Amaru juga dikaitkan dengan air yang mengairi ladang dan menjadi tumpuan hidup orang Aymara.
claims.quote: Amaru was also associated with the vital waters that irrigated the farmlands and upon which the Aymara people depended.

claims.statement: Amaru was also linked with the underworld, the earth and earthquakes.
claims.statement_id: Amaru juga dikaitkan dengan dunia bawah, bumi, dan gempa bumi.
claims.quote: In addition, Amaru was associated with the underworld, as well as the earth and earthquakes.

claims.statement: Though usually portrayed as benevolent, some amarus show a violent side.
claims.statement_id: Meski biasanya digambarkan baik, sebagian amaru menunjukkan sisi kejam.
claims.quote: Despite their usual benevolent portrayal, some Amarus display a violent side.

claims.statement: According to Professor Brian S. Bauer, amaru was often depicted as a winged serpent with crystalline eyes, a reddish snout, a llama head, taruka horns and a fish tail.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Profesor Brian S. Bauer, amaru sering digambarkan sebagai ular bersayap bermata kristal, bermoncong kemerahan, berkepala llama, bertanduk rusa taruka, dan berekor ikan.
claims.quote: According to Professor Brian S. Bauer, (Sacred serpent) was a serpent or dragon deity often depicted as a winged serpent, with crystalline eyes, a reddish snout, a llama head, taruka horns, and a fish tail

claims.statement: Its two heads religiously represent darkness and light.
claims.statement_id: Kedua kepalanya secara religius melambangkan kegelapan dan terang.
claims.quote: Les deux têtes représentent religieusement les ténèbres et la lumière

claims.statement: Atlacoya or Atlacoaya, "sad water", is the goddess of drought and dark waters in Mexica mythology.
claims.statement_id: Atlacoya atau Atlacoaya, "air yang sedih", adalah dewi kekeringan dan air kotor dalam mitologi Mexica.
claims.quote: Atlacoya, Atlacoaya (atla, aguas; tlaocoyani, triste), "agua triste" en la mitología mexica es la diosa de la sequía y de las aguas negras.

claims.statement: Her best-known depiction is in the Codex Magliabechiano, where Atlacoya talks with Mayáhuel, both wearing a quechquemitl and a sleeveless tunic.
claims.statement_id: Penggambarannya yang paling terkenal ada di Codex Magliabechiano, tempat Atlacoya bercakap dengan Mayáhuel; keduanya memakai quechquemitl dan tunik tanpa lengan.
claims.quote: Su más famosa representación se encuentra en el códice Magliabechiano donde Atlacoya conversa con Mayáhuel vestidas con una quechquemitl (una mantilla) y una túnica sin mangas.

claims.statement: Another source calls Atlacoaya the goddess of drought in Mixtec mythology.
claims.statement_id: Sumber lain menyebut Atlacoaya sebagai dewi kekeringan dalam mitologi Mixtek.
claims.quote: Atlacoaya (ou Atlacoya) est, dans la mythologie mixtèque, la déesse de la sécheresse.

claims.statement: The Mexican spider Scytodes atlacoya is named after the goddess.
claims.statement_id: Laba-laba Meksiko Scytodes atlacoya dinamai menurut dewi ini.
claims.quote: La déesse est repelèe en Scytodes atlacoya, une araignée du Mexique.

claims.statement: In Aztec mythology Atlacoya was the goddess of drought; this article also calls her a goddess of pulque.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Aztek, Atlacoya adalah dewi kekeringan; artikel ini juga menyebutnya dewi pulque.
claims.quote: Atlacoya nella mitologia azteca, era la dea della siccità. È anche da dea del pulque.

claims.statement: According to this article, Atlacoya is shown conversing with the goddess Mayahuel on folios 46 and 63; both wear a quechquemitl (a small cape) and sleeveless tunics.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, Atlacoya digambarkan bercakap dengan dewi Mayahuel pada lembar 46 dan 63; keduanya memakai quechquemitl (mantel kecil) dan tunik tanpa lengan.
claims.quote: (fogli 46 e 63) dove Atlacoya conversa con la dea Mayahuel ed entrambe indossano un quechquemitl (una mantellina) e delle tuniche senza maniche.

claims.statement: In Aztec mythology Atlacoya (Atlakoja) was the deity (isten) of drought and infertile lands.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Aztek, Atlacoya (Atlakoja) adalah dewa (isten) kekeringan dan tanah yang tidak subur.
claims.quote: Az azték mitológiában Atlakoja volt az aszály és a terméketlen földek istene.

claims.statement: In Brazilian native folklore, Boitatá refers to a will-o'-the-wisp, a mythical fire snake that guards fields and forests against people setting fires, or a bull-like creature.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat pribumi Brasil, Boitatá merujuk pada api gaib (will-o'-the-wisp), ular api mitos yang menjaga ladang dan hutan dari pembakaran oleh manusia, atau makhluk mirip banteng.
claims.quote: Boitatá (from Tupi language), in Brazilian native folklore, refers to either a will-o'-the-wisp, a mythical fire snake which guards against humans setting fire to the fields or forests, or a bull-like creature.

claims.statement: In Sergipe and Alagoas it is also called Jean de la foice or Jean Delafosse ("John of the sickle"), and on Itamaracá João Galafuz.
claims.statement_id: Di Sergipe dan Alagoas ia juga disebut Jean de la foice atau Jean Delafosse ("John si sabit"), dan di Itamaracá João Galafuz.
claims.quote: It is also called Jean de la foice or Jean Delafosse ("John of the sickle") in the states of Sergipe and Alagoas and João Galafuz on Itamaracá.

claims.statement: Alternatively it is a mythical bull that shoots fire from its nostrils.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pengertian lain, ia banteng mitos yang menyemburkan api dari lubang hidungnya.
claims.quote: Alternatively, it is a mythical bull that shoots fire out of its nostrils.

claims.statement: The term Boitatá is also used as papão, the bogeyman used to frighten children into obedience.
claims.statement_id: Istilah Boitatá juga dipakai sebagai papão, sosok momok untuk menakut-nakuti anak agar patuh.
claims.quote: The term Boitatá is also used as papão ... the Portuguese and Brazilian bogeyman to frighten children into obedience.

claims.statement: In a letter of 31 May 1560, Father José de Anchieta described the baetatá ("thing of fire"), usually found near sea and rivers, especially on beaches.
claims.statement_id: Dalam surat bertanggal 31 Mei 1560, Pastor José de Anchieta menggambarkan penampakan baetatá ("benda api"), yang biasanya berada dekat laut dan sungai, terutama di pantai.
claims.quote: In a letter dated 31 May 1560, Father José de Anchieta described the apparition as the baetatá (meaning "thing of fire" or "that which is entirely of fire"), dwelling at most times near sea and rivers, encountered especially on beaches.

claims.statement: Something like a glimmering beam of light rushes at its victims, burning and killing them.
claims.statement_id: Sesuatu yang tampak seperti berkas cahaya berkilau melesat ke arah korban dan menyerang, membakar, serta membunuh mereka.
claims.quote: What appears to be a glimmering beam of light coursing towards its victim will attack the Indians, burning and killing them.

claims.statement: According to Magalhães (1876), the fire snake Boitatá is one of the beings under the moon goddess Jaci, protector of all plants.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Magalhães (1876), ular api Boitatá adalah salah satu makhluk di bawah dewi bulan Jaci, pelindung semua tumbuhan.
claims.quote: The fire snake Boitatá (Mboitatá), according to Magalhães (1876), is one of the being subjected under the moon goddess Jaci ... the protectoress of all plants.

claims.statement: The fire snake sometimes turns into a burning log (méuan) and burns the arsonist to death.
claims.statement_id: Ular api ini kadang menjelma kayu menyala (méuan) dan membakar pelaku pembakaran sampai mati.
claims.quote: The fire-snake sometimes transforms into a fiery log (called méuan) and burns the arsonist to death.

claims.statement: This creature is a huge fire serpent that attacks anyone who harms the forests and animals of the Amazon.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini ular api raksasa yang menyerang siapa pun yang merusak hutan dan satwa Amazon.
claims.quote: Esta criatura es una enorme serpiente de fuego que ataca a quien haga daño a los bosques y animales de la Amazonia.

claims.statement: It is part of Brazilian folklore and also known in Paraguay, Uruguay and Argentina.
claims.statement_id: Boitatá bagian dari cerita rakyat Brasil dan juga dikenal di Paraguay, Uruguay, dan Argentina.
claims.quote: parte del folklore de Brasil, conocido también en Paraguay, Uruguay y Argentina.

claims.statement: The Chonchon is a mythical creature of Mapuche religion and the folk mythologies of Chile and southern Argentina.
claims.statement_id: Chonchon adalah makhluk mitos dalam agama Mapuche serta mitologi rakyat Chili dan Argentina selatan.
claims.quote: is a mythical creature found in Mapuche religion, as well as in the folk mythologies of Chile and southern Argentina.

claims.statement: According to Mapuche myth the flying head comes from someone, usually a woman, who makes a pact with a sorcerer; her head detaches at night, sprouts wings and flies off.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos Mapuche, kepala terbang ini berasal dari seseorang, biasanya perempuan, yang membuat perjanjian dengan penyihir; kepalanya lepas pada malam hari, bersayap, lalu terbang.
claims.quote: According to Mapuche myth the flying head is the result of someone, usually a woman, entering into a contract with a sorcerer or brujo; consequently her head detaches by night and sprout wings, so that the chonchón takes off in flight.

claims.statement: There is supposedly a secret underground place called the reni where she flies to join her coven.
claims.statement_id: Konon ada tempat rahasia di bawah tanah bernama reni, tempat ia terbang untuk berkumpul dengan kelompok penyihirnya.
claims.quote: There is supposedly a secret subterranean location called the reni, where she will fly to, to join her coven, to practice witchcraft or enjoy the festivities.

claims.statement: The kalku wizard himself can turn into the flying head.
claims.statement_id: Penyihir kalku sendiri dapat berubah menjadi kepala terbang itu.
claims.quote: Thus the kalku wizard himself can transform into the flying head.

claims.statement: To become a chonchon, the kalku anoints his throat with a magical cream.
claims.statement_id: Untuk menjadi chonchon, kalku mengoleskan krim ajaib di lehernya.
claims.quote: To become a chonchon, the kalku undergoes a voluntary transformation facilitated by an anointing with a magical cream on the throat.

claims.statement: The chonchon is a human head with feathers and talons; its huge ears act as wings for flying on moonless nights.
claims.statement_id: Chonchon berwujud kepala manusia berbulu dan bercakar; telinganya yang sangat besar berfungsi sebagai sayap untuk terbang pada malam tanpa bulan.
claims.quote: The chonchon takes the form of a human head adorned with feathers and talons. Its unusually large ears function as wings, enabling it to fly during moonless nights.

claims.statement: This form grants extra powers, including drinking the blood of the sick or sleeping.
claims.statement_id: Wujud ini memberi kemampuan tambahan, termasuk meminum darah orang sakit atau yang sedang tidur.
claims.quote: this transformation grants them additional abilities, including the ability to drink the blood of the sick or sleeping.

claims.statement: Ordinary people can still hear its cry, "tue tue tue", taken as a dire omen of a loved one's death.
claims.statement_id: Orang biasa tetap dapat mendengar teriakannya, "tue tue tue", yang dianggap pertanda buruk akan kematian orang tercinta.
claims.quote: they can still hear its distinctive cry of "tue tue tue." This cry is considered a dire omen and often predicts the impending death of a loved one.

claims.statement: According to Jorge Luis Borges's Book of Imaginary Beings, the chonchon shows itself only to sorcerers; others only hear its cry.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Book of Imaginary Beings karya Jorge Luis Borges, chonchon hanya memperlihatkan diri kepada penyihir; orang lain hanya mendengar suaranya.
claims.quote: ホルヘ・ルイス・ボルヘス『幻獣辞典』の記述によると、妖術師にしかその姿を見せないとされており、「チュエ、チュエ」という声のみが聴こえるとされる。

claims.statement: Kurupi is a figure of Guaraní mythology known for an elongated penis that winds around its waist, feared as an abductor and rapist of women.
claims.statement_id: Kurupi adalah tokoh mitologi Guaraní yang dikenal karena alat kelaminnya yang sangat panjang hingga melilit pinggang, dan ditakuti sebagai penculik serta pemerkosa perempuan.
claims.quote: is a figure in Guaraní mythology, known particularly for an elongated penis that can wind once or several turns around the waist or torso, or wrap around its arms, and feared as the abductor and rapist of women.

claims.statement: He is one of the seven monstrous children of Tau and Kerana, and so a central legendary figure in Guaraní-speaking regions.
claims.statement_id: Ia salah satu dari tujuh anak mengerikan Tau dan Kerana, sehingga menjadi tokoh legenda utama di wilayah berbahasa Guaraní.
claims.quote: He is one of the seven monstrous children of Tau and Kerana, and as such is one of the central legendary figures in the region of Guaraní speaking cultures.

claims.statement: The modern so-called Paraguayan Kurupi is short like a child or an old man, ugly and hairy.
claims.statement_id: Versi modern yang disebut versi Paraguay menggambarkan Kurupi bertubuh pendek seperti anak atau orang tua, buruk rupa, dan berbulu.
claims.quote: The modern so-called "Paraguayan" variety of Curupi/Kurupi is said to be short or small-bodied (like a child or be agéd), ugly, and hairy (or naked)

claims.statement: Its backward-pointing feet confuse anyone following its tracks and lead people into the thicket.
claims.statement_id: Kakinya yang menghadap ke belakang mengecoh orang yang mengikuti jejaknya dan menyesatkan mereka ke semak belukar.
claims.quote: This curupí's backward-pointing feet. will confuse anyone following its tracks and lead humans into the thicket or underbrush

claims.statement: It is also regarded as a protector of nature.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga dianggap pelindung alam.
claims.quote: It is also regarded as a protector of nature.

claims.statement: Some informants say it can turn invisible to defend itself and that it kidnaps women and children.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sebagian narasumber, ia dapat menjadi tak terlihat untuk membela diri dan menculik perempuan serta anak-anak.
claims.quote: According to some informants, it has the power of invisibility, and uses it as a form of defense, and kidnaps women and children using its penis as a lasso.

claims.statement: The supposed existence of the Curupi was recorded in explorer Juan Francisco Aguirre's 1793 diary.
claims.statement_id: Keberadaan Curupi tercatat dalam buku harian penjelajah Juan Francisco Aguirre tahun 1793.
claims.quote: The purported existence of the Curupi was logged in the 1793 diary of the explorer Juan Francisco Aguirre.

claims.statement: Kurupi's appearance is often compared to that of Pombero, another important figure of Guaraní mythology.
claims.statement_id: Penampilan Kurupi sering disamakan dengan Pombero, tokoh penting lain dalam mitologi Guaraní.
claims.quote: L'apparence de Kurupi est fréquemment rapprochée de celle de Pombero, un autre personnage important de la mythologie Guarani.

claims.statement: The Guaraní are Indigenous American peoples of the Amazonian regions of Brazil and Paraguay.
claims.statement_id: Orang Guaraní adalah kelompok penduduk asli Amerika dari wilayah Amazon di Brasil dan Paraguay.
claims.quote: Les Guaraní sont un groupe de populations amérindiennes des régions amazoniennes du Brésil et du Paraguay.

claims.statement: Kurupi is one of the few legendary figures still prominent in the region's present-day cultures.
claims.statement_id: Kurupi termasuk sedikit tokoh legenda yang masih menonjol dalam budaya masa kini di wilayah itu.
claims.quote: Il est également l'une des rares figures légendaires encore prééminente dans les cultures actuelles de cette région.

claims.statement: Piasa is a later name for the creature(s) of Native American mythology shown in a mural painted high on cliffs above the Mississippi River.
claims.statement_id: Piasa adalah nama belakangan untuk makhluk mitologi penduduk asli Amerika yang dilukis pada mural tinggi di tebing di atas Sungai Mississippi.
claims.quote: is a later name applied to the creature[s] from Native American mythology depicted in a mural painted by Native Americans high on cliffsides above the Mississippi River.

claims.statement: Its original site was at the end of a chain of limestone bluffs in Madison County, at present-day Alton, Illinois.
claims.statement_id: Lokasi aslinya di ujung deretan tebing kapur di Madison County, kini Alton, Illinois.
claims.quote: Its original location was at the end of a chain of limestone bluffs in Madison County, Illinois, at present-day Alton, Illinois.

claims.statement: French explorers Marquette and Louis Jolliet (1673) described the original paintings as a multicoloured human-faced creature with a long fish-finned tail.
claims.statement_id: Lukisan aslinya digambarkan penjelajah Prancis Marquette dan Louis Jolliet (1673) sebagai makhluk berwajah manusia, berwarna-warni, dengan ekor panjang bersirip ikan.
claims.quote: The original petrographs were described by French explorers Marquette and Louis Jolliet (1673) and described as a multicolored human-faced creature with a long tail terminating in fish-like fin.

claims.statement: A contemporary sketch shows a wingless, scaly four-legged beast identifiable as the underwater panther type.
claims.statement_id: Sketsa sezaman menunjukkan makhluk tanpa sayap, berkaki empat dan bersisik, yang dapat dikenali sebagai jenis panter bawah air.
claims.quote: Contemporary sketch of one of the beasts, which is wingless (and matching the description of a scaly quadruped with a man-like face and a long tail terminating in fishlike fins) is identifiable as the underwater panther type.

claims.statement: Folklorists consider the legend of chieftain Ouatoga fighting the bird to be fakelore invented by John Russell (1836, 1848).
claims.statement_id: Para ahli folklor menganggap legenda kepala suku Ouatoga yang melawan burung itu sebagai cerita rakyat palsu karangan John Russell (1836, 1848).
claims.quote: deeming the attached legend of the chieftain Ouatoga (who fended his tribe from the bird, protected by a divine invisible shield) to be fakelore, i.e., a piece of fiction by John Russell (1836, 1848)

claims.statement: The wall bearing the original paintings at Alton was probably destroyed around the 1850s.
claims.statement_id: Dinding tempat lukisan asli di Alton kemungkinan hancur sekitar tahun 1850-an.
claims.quote: The wall where the original paintings existed at Alton was probably destroyed ca. 1850s.

claims.statement: The mural was restored with replicas several times in the 20th century.
claims.statement_id: Pada abad ke-20 mural ini beberapa kali dipulihkan dengan replika.
claims.quote: The mural has been restored with replicas a number of times in the 20th century

claims.statement: Another source calls the piasa a 19th-century invention passed off as a legendary creature of Native North American mythology.
claims.statement_id: Sumber lain menyebut piasa makhluk rekaan abad ke-19 yang diklaim sebagai makhluk legenda penduduk asli Amerika Utara.
claims.quote: El piasa es una criatura ficticia inventada en el siglo XIX y hecha pasar por una supuesta criatura legendaria propia de la mitología de los nativos norteamericanos

claims.statement: Marquette wrote that on one of the rocks they saw two painted monsters which at first made them afraid, and upon which the boldest savages dare not rest their eyes for long.
claims.statement_id: Marquette menulis bahwa di salah satu tebing mereka melihat dua monster lukisan yang pada mulanya membuat rombongan takut, dan yang oleh orang-orang paling berani pun tidak berani ditatap lama.
claims.quote: We saw upon one of them two painted monsters which at first made Us afraid, and upon Which the boldest savages dare not Long rest their eyes.

claims.statement: In Marquette's account the two painted monsters are as large as a calf, with deer-like horns, red eyes, a tiger's beard, a face somewhat like a man's, a scaly body, and a tail that winds all around the body.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan Marquette, kedua lukisan itu sebesar anak sapi, bertanduk seperti rusa, bermata merah, berjanggut seperti harimau, berwajah agak mirip manusia, bertubuh bersisik, dengan ekor yang melilit seluruh tubuh.
claims.quote: They are as large As a calf; they have Horns on their heads Like those of a deer, a horrible look, red eyes, a beard Like a tiger's, a face somewhat like a man's, a body Covered with scales, and so Long A tail that it winds all around the Body

claims.statement: In 1836 John Russell published an article entitled "The Bird That Devours Men" and called the monster the Piasa Bird for the first time; the Illinois State Museum says much of the legend he related he created himself.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1836 John Russell menerbitkan artikel "The Bird That Devours Men" dan untuk pertama kali menyebut monster itu Piasa Bird; Illinois State Museum menyatakan sebagian besar legenda yang ia ceritakan ia karang sendiri.
claims.quote: In 1836 John Russell of Bluffdale, Ill., published an article entitled "The Bird That Devours Men," and called the monster the Piasa Bird for the first time. Russell related a legend, much of which he created, which persists as the explanation of the pictograph.

claims.statement: According to Russell, the Piasa Bird was a huge flying monster that lived on the cliffs, destroyed Indian villages, consumed its captives, and resisted efforts to destroy it; Chief Ouatoga, in a dream inspired by the Great Spirit, conceived a plan to kill it.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tulisan Russell, Burung Piasa adalah monster terbang besar yang hidup di tebing, menghancurkan desa-desa Indian, memakan tawanannya, dan melawan upaya membunuhnya; Kepala Suku Ouatoga, dalam mimpi yang diilhami Roh Agung, menyusun rencana untuk membunuhnya.
claims.quote: The Piasa Bird, Russell wrote, was a huge flying monster which lived on the cliffs, destroyed Indian villages, consumed its captives, and resisted efforts to destroy it. Chief Ouatoga, however, during a dream inspired by the Great Spirit, conceived a plan to kill the terrible bird.

claims.statement: In that tale, using himself as bait and 20 of his bravest warriors to launch poisoned arrows, Ouatoga's plan succeeded and the Piasa Bird fell into the Mississippi and drowned.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah itu, dengan dirinya sebagai umpan dan 20 prajurit terberaninya melepaskan panah beracun, rencana Ouatoga berhasil dan Burung Piasa jatuh ke Mississippi lalu tenggelam.
claims.quote: Using himself as bait and 20 of his bravest warriors to launch poisoned arrows, Ouatoga's plan succeeded and the Piasa Bird fell into the Mississippi and drowned.

claims.statement: Russell claimed this creature attacked and devoured people in nearby Indian villages shortly after the corpses of a war gave it a taste for human flesh.
claims.statement_id: Russell mengklaim makhluk itu menyerang dan memakan orang di desa-desa Indian terdekat setelah mayat-mayat sebuah perang memberinya selera akan daging manusia.
claims.quote: Russell claimed that this creature attacked and devoured people in nearby Indian villages shortly after the corpses of a war gave it a taste for human flesh.

claims.statement: In Armstrong's version, one bellowed like a bull and the other roared like a panther; at first they did not bring humans into harm's way aside from the terrible noises, but then the birds interceded in the tribal wars on the side of the "Mestchegamies", causing the Miami to be routed.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi Armstrong, satu burung menggeram seperti banteng dan yang lain mengaum seperti panter; semula mereka tidak mencelakai manusia selain lewat suara mengerikan, tetapi kemudian mereka ikut campur dalam perang suku di pihak "Mestchegamies" sehingga Miami terpukul mundur.
claims.quote: One bellowed like a bull, the other roared like a panther, but aside from the terrible noises they issued, originally did not bring humans into harm's way. However, the birds interceded in the tribal wars on the side of the "Mestchegamies" causing the Miami to be routed.

claims.statement: Douay and Hennepin add that according to native lore a tribal war occurred at this pictograph location in which many Miami warriors were drowned in the pursuit by the Matsigamea (Mitchigamea), and that since then the natives use smoke or offer tobacco to the pictorial beasts to appease the Manitou.
claims.statement_id: Douay dan Hennepin menambahkan bahwa menurut kisah pribumi, di lokasi lukisan itu pernah terjadi perang suku ketika banyak prajurit Miami tenggelam dalam pengejaran oleh Matsigamea (Mitchigamea), dan sejak itu orang pribumi memakai asap atau mempersembahkan tembakau kepada lukisan binatang itu untuk menenangkan Manitou.
claims.quote: Both Douay and Hennepin add that according to native lore, a tribal war occurred at this pictograph location in which many Miami warriors were drowned in the pursuit by the Matsigamea (Mitchigamea), and that the natives since then use smoke or make offerings of tobacco to the pictorial beasts, to appease the Manitou.

claims.statement: Linguist Albert S. Gatschet (1899) described Lenapízha as "an awe-inspiring animal of the dragon species, and of enormous dimensions".
claims.statement_id: Ahli bahasa Albert S. Gatschet (1899) menggambarkan Lenapízha sebagai "hewan yang menggentarkan dari jenis naga, dan berukuran sangat besar".
claims.quote: But linguist Albert S. Gatschet (1899) further described Lenapízha as "an awe-inspiring animal of the dragon species, and of enormous dimensions"

claims.statement: Costa goes as far as to say that the Piasa depicted in the rock art (underwater panther) and another "Piasa" at least have in common the habit of attacking river travelers.
claims.statement_id: Costa berpendapat bahwa Piasa pada seni cadas (macan air) dan Piasa lain setidaknya sama-sama punya kebiasaan menyerang pelancong sungai.
claims.quote: Costa goes as far as to say that the Piasa depicted in the rock art (underwater panther) and the Piasa ... do at least have the habit of attacking river travelers in common.

claims.statement: Qʼuqʼumatz was a god of wind and rain of the Postclassic Kʼicheʼ Maya.
claims.statement_id: Qʼuqʼumatz adalah dewa angin dan hujan bangsa Maya Kʼicheʼ zaman Pascaklasik.
claims.quote: was a god of wind and rain of the Postclassic Kʼicheʼ Maya.

claims.statement: According to the Popol Vuh, this Feathered Serpent created the world and humanity together with the god Tepeu.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Popol Vuh, Ular Berbulu ini menciptakan dunia dan manusia bersama dewa Tepeu.
claims.quote: It was the Feathered Serpent that according to the Popol Vuh created the world and humanity, together with the god Tepeu.

claims.statement: It carried the sun across the sky and into the underworld and mediated between the powers of the Maya cosmos.
claims.statement_id: Ia membawa matahari melintasi langit dan turun ke dunia bawah, serta menjadi penengah berbagai kekuatan dalam kosmos Maya.
claims.quote: carried the sun across the sky and down into the underworld and acted as a mediator between the various powers in the Maya cosmos.

claims.statement: It is considered the equivalent of the Aztec god Quetzalcoatl and of Kukulkan of the Yucatec Maya.
claims.statement_id: Ia dianggap padanan dewa Aztek Quetzalcoatl dan Kukulkan dari Maya Yukatek.
claims.quote: It is considered to be the equivalent of the Aztec god Quetzalcoatl and of Kukulkan, of the Yucatec Maya.

claims.statement: With Tepeu, god of lightning and fire, it was considered the mythical male-line ancestor of the Kʼicheʼ nobility.
claims.statement_id: Bersama Tepeu, dewa petir dan api, ia dianggap leluhur mitis bangsawan Kʼicheʼ melalui garis laki-laki.
claims.quote: Together with Tepeu, god of lightning and fire, it was considered to be the mythical ancestor of the Kʼicheʼ nobility by direct male line.

claims.statement: Kotujaʼ, the Kʼicheʼ king who founded Qʼumarkaj, bore the god's name as a title and was probably once its priest.
claims.statement_id: Kotujaʼ, raja Kʼicheʼ pendiri kota Qʼumarkaj, memakai nama dewa ini sebagai gelar dan mungkin dulunya pendetanya.
claims.quote: Kotujaʼ, the Kʼicheʼ king who founded the city of Qʼumarkaj, bore the name of the deity as a title and was likely to have been a former priest of the god.

claims.statement: The name literally means "quetzal serpent", though it is often less accurately rendered "feathered serpent".
claims.statement_id: Namanya secara harfiah berarti "ular quetzal", meski sering diterjemahkan kurang tepat sebagai "ular berbulu".
claims.quote: translates literally as "quetzal serpent" although it is often rendered less accurately as "feathered serpent".

claims.statement: Qʼuqʼumatz may once have been the same god as Tohil, the Kʼicheʼ sun god, but they later diverged and each had its own priesthood.
claims.statement_id: Qʼuqʼumatz mungkin awalnya dewa yang sama dengan Tohil, dewa matahari Kʼicheʼ, tetapi keduanya kemudian terpisah dan memiliki pendeta masing-masing.
claims.quote: Qʼuqʼumatz may originally have been the same god as Tohil, the Kʼicheʼ sun god who also had attributes of the feathered serpent, but they later diverged and each deity came to have a separate priesthood.

claims.statement: Q'uq'umatz is the Feathered Serpent god of the Popol Vuh who created humans together with the god Tepeu.
claims.statement_id: Q'uq'umatz adalah dewa Ular Berbulu dalam Popol Vuh yang menciptakan manusia bersama dewa Tepeu.
claims.quote: Q'uq'umatz adalah dewa Ular Berbulu dalam kisah Popol Vuh. Ia menciptakan manusia bersama dengan dewa Tepeu.

claims.statement: The Saci or Saci-pererê is a popular figure of Brazilian mythology.
claims.statement_id: Saci atau Saci-pererê adalah tokoh populer dalam mitologi Brasil.
claims.quote: Der Saci oder Saci-pererê ist eine populäre Figur der brasilianischen Mythologie.

claims.statement: Saci is a goblin-like, black-skinned, one-legged being who smokes a pipe, begs people for tobacco and wears a magic red cap that lets him appear and vanish at any time, usually in a dust devil.
claims.statement_id: Saci makhluk mirip kobold berkulit hitam dan berkaki satu yang mengisap pipa, meminta tembakau kepada orang, dan memakai topi merah ajaib untuk muncul dan menghilang kapan saja, biasanya dalam pusaran debu.
claims.quote: Er ist ein koboldähnliches Wesen mit schwarzer Hautfarbe und nur einem Bein. Er raucht eine Pfeife, bettelt die Menschen um Tabak an und trägt eine magische rote Mütze, mit deren Hilfe er jederzeit auftauchen und wieder verschwinden kann (meist in einem Staubwirbel).

claims.statement: Depending on the region he was a good or a bad being.
claims.statement_id: Tergantung daerahnya, ia makhluk baik atau jahat.
claims.quote: Je nach Region war er ein gutes oder schlechtes Wesen

claims.statement: In his malicious version the Saci served as a bogeyman for children among slaves and farm workers (caboclos).
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi jahatnya, Saci dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak di kalangan budak dan buruh tani (caboclo).
claims.quote: In seiner boshaften Varietät diente der Saci als Kinderschreck bei den Sklaven und Landarbeitern (Caboclos).

claims.statement: A captured Saci can be shut in a bottle and made to grant wishes in exchange for freedom, like Aladdin and the Magic Lamp.
claims.statement_id: Saci yang tertangkap dapat dikurung dalam botol dan dipaksa mengabulkan permintaan sebagai tebusan kebebasannya, mirip kisah Aladin dan lampu ajaib.
claims.quote: The captured Saci can be imprisoned inside a bottle, and be forced to grant wishes in exchange for freedom, just like Aladdin and the Magic Lamp in Arabian Nights.

claims.statement: The word saci comes from Tupinambá çaci, "sick eye", or rather çua ci, "evil eye".
claims.statement_id: Kata saci berasal dari bahasa Tupinambá çaci, "mata sakit", atau lebih tepatnya çua ci, "mata jahat".
claims.quote: The term saci derives from Tupinambá: çaci meaning "sick eye", or rather Tupinambá: çua ci "evil eye".

claims.statement: The suffix -pererê comes from Tupinambá perérég, meaning "bouncy, jumpy".
claims.statement_id: Akhiran -pererê berasal dari kata Tupinambá perérég yang berarti "melompat-lompat".
claims.quote: The suffixed -pererê also derives from Tupinambá perérég meaning "bouncy, jumpy".

claims.statement: The name Saci-pererê originally referred to a bird of the cuckoo family, the striped cuckoo.
claims.statement_id: Nama Saci-pererê awalnya merujuk pada sejenis burung kukuk, yaitu kukuk bergaris.
claims.quote: The Saci-pererê of myth originally referred to a Cuculiformes (cuckoo family) bird, more specifically the striped cuckoo.

claims.statement: In Inuit religion Adlivun are the spirits of the dead living in the underworld, and by extension the underworld itself, beneath land and sea.
claims.statement_id: Dalam agama Inuit, Adlivun adalah roh orang mati yang tinggal di dunia bawah, dan juga dunia bawah itu sendiri, di bawah daratan dan laut.
claims.quote: are the spirits of the departed who reside in the underworld, and by extension the underworld itself, located beneath the land and the sea.

claims.statement: There the souls are purified before travelling to the Land of the Moon.
claims.statement_id: Di sana jiwa-jiwa disucikan sebagai persiapan perjalanan ke Negeri Bulan.
claims.quote: The souls are purified there, in preparation for the travel to the Land of the Moon

claims.statement: Adlivun is usually described as a frozen wasteland.
claims.statement_id: Adlivun biasanya digambarkan sebagai padang beku yang tandus.
claims.quote: live in Adlivun, which is usually described as a frozen wasteland.

claims.statement: Sedna rules the land and is said to imprison souls to prepare them for the next stage of their journey.
claims.statement_id: Sedna menguasai negeri itu dan konon menahan jiwa-jiwa sebagai persiapan tahap perjalanan berikutnya.
claims.quote: Sedna is the ruler of the land, and is said to imprison the souls of the living as part of the preparation for the next stage of their journey.

claims.statement: The psychopomps Pinga and Anguta bring the dead to Adlivun, where they stay a year before moving on.
claims.statement_id: Pemandu jiwa Pinga dan Anguta membawa jiwa orang mati ke Adlivun, tempat mereka tinggal setahun sebelum melanjutkan perjalanan.
claims.quote: The psychopomps Pinga and Anguta bring the souls of the dead to Adlivun, where they must stay for one year before moving on.

claims.statement: When an Inuk dies, the body is wrapped in caribou skin and buried.
claims.statement_id: Ketika seorang Inuk meninggal, jenazahnya dibungkus kulit karibu lalu dikuburkan.
claims.quote: When an Inuk dies, they are wrapped in caribou skin and buried.

claims.statement: Adlivun means "those who live beneath us".
claims.statement_id: Adlivun berarti "mereka yang hidup di bawah kita".
claims.quote: Adlivun signifie "ceux qui vivent en dessous de nous"

claims.statement: Adlivun is also known as Idliragijenget.
claims.statement_id: Adlivun juga dikenal sebagai Idliragijenget.
claims.quote: Adlivun, également connu sous le nom d'Idliragijenget

claims.statement: Adlivun is the first world to which the dead are sent after death.
claims.statement_id: Adlivun adalah dunia pertama tempat orang mati dikirim setelah meninggal.
claims.quote: Adlivun est le premier monde où sont envoyés les défunts après leur mort.

claims.statement: In Inuit religion Agloolik is a spirit living beneath the ice of the Arctic Ocean that guards and protects seals.
claims.statement_id: Dalam agama Inuit, Agloolik adalah roh yang hidup di bawah es Samudra Arktik dan menjadi penjaga yang melindungi anjing laut.
claims.quote: is a spirit that lives underneath the ice of the Arctic Ocean and acts as tutelary guardian for the protection of seals.

claims.statement: It is said to help fishermen and hunters; if Inuit hunters pray to it before fishing, Agloolik blesses them with prey.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikatakan menolong nelayan dan pemburu; bila pemburu Inuit berdoa kepadanya sebelum menangkap ikan, Agloolik memberkati mereka dengan hasil buruan.
claims.quote: It is said to provide aid to fishermen and hunters. If Inuit hunters prayed to the spirit before fishing, Agloolik will bless them with prey.

claims.statement: Agloolik is a benevolent spirit living under the ice that always helps hunters and fishers.
claims.statement_id: Agloolik adalah roh baik hati yang hidup di bawah es dan selalu membantu pemburu dan nelayan.
claims.quote: Agloolik est un esprit bienfaisant qui vit sous la glace et aide en permanence les chasseurs et les pêcheurs

claims.statement: Agloolik is also a character in the game Final Fantasy XI, shown as a warlike spirit of the world of Vana'diel.
claims.statement_id: Agloolik juga nama tokoh dalam gim Final Fantasy XI, digambarkan sebagai roh yang suka berperang dari dunia Vana'diel.
claims.quote: Agloolik désigne également un personnage du jeu Final Fantasy XI, qui est représenté comme un esprit belliqueux du monde Vana'diel

claims.statement: In Inuit mythology Agloolik is the guardian of young seals, a spirit living under the ice that is well disposed toward people and helps them in hunting and fishing.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Inuit, Agloolik adalah penjaga anak anjing laut, roh yang tinggal di bawah es, bersikap baik kepada manusia dan menolong mereka saat berburu dan memancing.
claims.quote: Agloolik är i den inuitiska mytologin ungsälarnas väktare, en ande bosatt under isen, som är välvilligt inställd till människorna och hjälper dem under jakt och fiske.

claims.statement: Agloolik, also written Aglookik, is a protector of seals in Inuit mythology, a spirit living under the ice.
claims.statement_id: Agloolik, juga ditulis Aglookik, adalah pelindung hewan anjing laut dalam mitologi Inuit, roh yang tinggal di bawah es.
claims.quote: Agloolik tai Aglookik on inuiittien mytologian hylje-eläinten suojelija, henki joka asuu jään alla.

claims.statement: According to this article, Agloolik's enemy is Sedna, a malicious sea goddess.
claims.statement_id: Menurut artikel ini, musuh Agloolik adalah Sedna, dewi laut yang jahat.
claims.quote: Agloolikin vihollinen on häijy meren jumalatar Sedna.

claims.statement: Agloolik appears on one of the cards of the collectible card game Deus, published in 1996: card 158, in the Eskimaux series.
claims.statement_id: Agloolik muncul pada salah satu kartu permainan kartu koleksi Deus yang terbit tahun 1996, yaitu kartu 158 dalam seri Eskimaux.
claims.quote: Agloolik apparait sur une des cartes du jeu de cartes à collectionner Deus paru en 1996, il s'agit plus précisément de la carte 158 Agloolik dans la série des Eskimaux.

claims.statement: In Chilean mythology the alicanto is a nocturnal flightless bird of the Atacama desert that runs at night with outspread wings glittering gold or silver from the ores it eats.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Chili, alicanto adalah burung malam yang tidak bisa terbang dari Gurun Atacama; ia berlari dengan sayap terbentang yang berkilau emas atau perak dari bijih logam yang dimakannya.
claims.quote: The alicanto, in Chilean mythology, is a nocturnal flightless bird of the Atacama desert, which is said to run at night with glowing outspread wings, glittering in the gold or silver color deriving from the precious ores it supposedly eats.

claims.statement: If followed unnoticed, the bird leads the miner to a rich vein of gold or silver.
claims.statement_id: Bila diikuti tanpa ketahuan, burung ini menuntun penambang ke urat emas atau perak.
claims.quote: If the bird can be successfully detected without being noticed, it will lead the miner or prospector to a mother lode of gold or silver.

claims.statement: If it notices a human, it puts out its light and vanishes into darkness, or leads the person off a cliff.
claims.statement_id: Bila ia menyadari ada manusia, cahayanya padam dan ia menghilang dalam gelap, atau menuntun orang itu jatuh dari tebing.
claims.quote: But if the bird detects a human, it is said to extinguish its illumination, then disappear into darkness, or worse, lead the human to a perilous fall from a precipice.

claims.statement: The cave-dwelling female lays only two eggs, of gold or silver depending on the ore it eats.
claims.statement_id: Alicanto betina yang tinggal di gua bertelur hanya dua butir, dari emas atau perak sesuai bijih yang dimakannya.
claims.quote: Also the cave-dwelling alicanto female will lay just two eggs, of gold or silver, depending on the ore it feeds on

claims.statement: It cannot fly because the ore it eats weighs it down in its crop.
claims.statement_id: Ia tidak bisa terbang karena bijih logam yang dimakannya menumpuk di temboloknya dan memberatkannya.
claims.quote: its flightlessness is due to the massive amount of ore it eats that sits in its crop and loads it down.

claims.statement: A popular story holds that the silver outcrop found on 16 May 1832, which set off Chile's silver rush, was discovered by miner Juan Godoy guided by an alicanto.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita yang beredar, penemuan singkapan perak pada 16 Mei 1832 yang memicu demam perak Chili dilakukan penambang Juan Godoy yang dituntun burung alicanto.
claims.quote: チリのシルバーラッシュ ... の引き金になったのが、1832年5月16日の銀の露頭の発見であるが、これは鉱夫のフアン・ゴドイ ... がアリカント鳥に導かれて発見したのだという巷説がある。

claims.statement: Folklorist Julio Vicuña Cifuentes described the alicanto in 1914/1915, and similar content appears in the Fauna of Chile chapter of the expanded English edition of Borges's Book of Imaginary Beings (1969).
claims.statement_id: Folkloris Julio Vicuña Cifuentes menguraikan alicanto pada 1914/1915, dan isi serupa dimuat di bab Fauna of Chile dalam edisi Inggris Book of Imaginary Beings karya Borges (1969).
claims.quote: アリカントについては、民俗学者のフリオ・ヴィクーニャ・シフエンテス ... が1914/1915年に解説しているが、同様の内容が、ボルヘス著『幻獣辞典』 の拡張英訳版（1969年）の、「チリの動物 Fauna of Chile」の章に収められている。

claims.statement: In Georgia folklore the Altamaha-ha (Altie) is a legendary creature said to live in the streams and abandoned rice fields near the mouth of the Altamaha River in southeastern Georgia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Georgia, Altamaha-ha (Altie) adalah makhluk legendaris yang konon menghuni anak-anak sungai dan bekas sawah dekat muara Sungai Altamaha di Georgia tenggara.
claims.quote: In Georgia folklore, the Altamaha-ha (or Altie) is a legendary creature, alleged to inhabit the myriad small streams and abandoned rice fields near the mouth of the Altamaha River (after which it is named) in southeastern Georgia.

claims.statement: Sightings are reported especially around Darien and elsewhere in McIntosh County.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan terutama dilaporkan di sekitar Darien dan tempat lain di McIntosh County.
claims.quote: Sightings are particularly reported around Darien and elsewhere in McIntosh County.

claims.statement: According to The Brunswick News, the legend is rooted in Muscogee tradition.
claims.statement_id: Menurut The Brunswick News, legenda ini berakar pada tradisi Muscogee.
claims.quote: According to The Brunswick News, the legend has its roots in Muscogee tradition.

claims.statement: An alligator gar has been proposed as a possible explanation for recent sightings.
claims.statement_id: Ikan alligator gar diajukan sebagai kemungkinan penjelasan penampakan belakangan ini.
claims.quote: An alligator gar has been proposed as being a possible identity for recent sightings attributed to the creature.

claims.statement: In 2018 decomposing remains found on a beach in the Wolf Island National Wildlife Refuge prompted speculation that they were an Altamaha-ha.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2018 bangkai membusuk ditemukan di pantai Wolf Island National Wildlife Refuge dan diduga bangkai Altamaha-ha.
claims.quote: In 2018, decomposing remains were found on a beach in the Wolf Island National Wildlife Refuge, causing speculation that it may be the body of an Altamaha-ha.

claims.statement: Performance artist Zardulu later claimed to have made the remains from a stuffed shark and papier-mâché.
claims.statement_id: Seniman pertunjukan Zardulu kemudian mengaku membuatnya dari hiu yang diawetkan dan bubur kertas.
claims.quote: Performance artist Zardulu later claimed responsibility for the remains, which were created out of a stuffed shark and papier-mâché.

claims.statement: In the video game South of Midnight, Altamaha-ha is a boss Hazel meets in a dark swamp.
claims.statement_id: Dalam gim South of Midnight, Altamaha-ha muncul sebagai musuh utama yang ditemui Hazel di rawa gelap.
claims.quote: In the videogame South of Midnight, Altamaha-ha is featured as a boss that Hazel encounters in a dark swamp.

claims.statement: The first formal sighting dates to 1700; older information comes from Native Americans who believed a giant serpent-like creature lived in the Altamaha River.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan resmi pertama tercatat sejak 1700; informasi yang lebih tua berasal dari penduduk asli yang percaya ada makhluk mirip ular raksasa di Sungai Altamaha.
claims.quote: 奥尔塔马霍河水怪的第一次正式目击可以追溯至1700年，更早之前的信息来自印第安人，他们认为奥尔塔马霍河生存着一只类似巨蛇的生物。

claims.statement: Believers describe an animal 30 feet long with flippers like a seal.
claims.statement_id: Para penganutnya menggambarkan hewan sepanjang 30 kaki dengan sirip seperti anjing laut.
claims.quote: Believers, however, tell of a 30-foot long animal with flippers like a seal.

claims.statement: The primary eyewitness was Captain Delano of the schooner Eagle, who saw a monster off St. Simons Island below the mouth of the Altamaha.
claims.statement_id: Saksi utama adalah Kapten Delano dari kapal layar Eagle, yang melihat monster di lepas St. Simons Island, di bawah muara Altamaha.
claims.quote: The primary eyewitness was a Captain Delano of the schooner Eagle, who saw a monster off St. Simons Island below the mouth of the Altamaha

claims.statement: The witness described the animal as about 70 feet long, its circumference about that of a sugar hogshead, moving with its head (shaped like an alligator's) about 8 feet out of the water.
claims.statement_id: Saksi itu menggambarkan hewan yang dilihatnya sekitar 70 kaki panjangnya, lingkarnya seukuran hogshead gula, bergerak dengan kepala (berbentuk seperti kepala aligator) terangkat sekitar 8 kaki dari air.
claims.quote: describing the animal he saw as being about 70 feet long, and its circumference about that of a sugar hogshead, moving with its head (shaped like an Alligator's) about 8 feet out of the water.

claims.statement: Five men on the schooner also saw it, and a number of planters from St. Simons Island told the correspondent they had seen something strange as well.
claims.statement_id: Lima orang di kapal layar itu juga melihatnya, dan sejumlah pemilik perkebunan dari St. Simons Island berkata kepada koresponden bahwa mereka juga melihat sesuatu yang aneh.
claims.quote: Five men on the schooner also saw it and a number of planters from St. Simons Island told the correspondent that they had seen something strange as well.

claims.statement: A correspondent of the Savannah Georgian newspaper reported multiple sightings of a sea monster on the Georgia coast in a dispatch datelined in Darien on April 18, 1830.
claims.statement_id: Seorang koresponden surat kabar Savannah Georgian melaporkan beberapa penampakan monster laut di pesisir Georgia dalam kiriman berita bertanggal Darien, 18 April 1830.
claims.quote: a correspondent of the Savannah Georgian newspaper reported multiple sightings of a sea monster on the Georgia coast in a dispatch datelined in Darien on April 18, 1830.

claims.statement: The witnesses said it had two big humps about five feet apart and left behind a wake like that of a speedboat.
claims.statement_id: Para saksi mengatakan ia punya dua punuk besar yang berjarak sekitar lima kaki dan meninggalkan riak seperti perahu cepat.
claims.quote: They said it had two big humps about five feet apart and left behind a wake like that of a speedboat.

claims.statement: A witness said it left behind a billow of water so big that boats bumped about. One of the men with him ran for a rifle, but it was gone before he could get off a shot.
claims.statement_id: Seorang saksi mengatakan makhluk itu meninggalkan gulungan air yang begitu besar sampai perahu terombang-ambing. Salah satu rekannya berlari mengambil senapan, tetapi makhluk itu sudah hilang sebelum sempat ditembak.
claims.quote: He said it left behind a billow of water so big that it caused boats to bump about. One of the men with him ran for a rifle, but it was gone before he could get off a shot.

claims.statement: Tradition holds that the Tama Indians who lived up the Altamaha had legends of a giant snake-like creature living in the river, but the author notes that no documentation has been found to verify the claim.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tradisi, orang Tama yang tinggal di hulu Altamaha punya legenda makhluk raksasa mirip ular yang hidup di sungai itu, tetapi penulis mencatat bahwa belum ditemukan dokumentasi yang membuktikan klaim ini.
claims.quote: Tradition holds that the Tama Indians who lived up the Altamaha had legends of a giant snake-like creature that lived in the river. No documentation has been found to verify the claim

claims.statement: Some say what is seen is nothing but floating logs, masses of vegetation or known marine creatures.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang berpendapat yang terlihat hanyalah kayu apung, gumpalan tumbuhan, atau hewan laut yang sudah dikenal.
claims.quote: Some, of course, say it is nothing but floating logs, masses of vegetation or known marine creatures.

claims.statement: Reports indicate it is 20-30 feet long, though some have seen smaller or larger creatures.
claims.statement_id: Laporan menyebut panjangnya 20-30 kaki, meskipun ada yang melihat makhluk lebih kecil atau lebih besar.
claims.quote: Reports indicate it is 20-30 feet long, though some have seen smaller or larger creatures

claims.statement: This cryptid is described as having a sturgeon-like body with a bony ridge on top, front flippers and no back limbs, swimming like a dolphin and having a crocodile-like snout.
claims.statement_id: Kriptid ini digambarkan bertubuh mirip ikan sturgeon dengan punggung bergerigi tulang, bersirip depan tanpa tungkai belakang, berenang seperti lumba-lumba, dan bermoncong mirip buaya.
claims.quote: This strange cryptid is described as having a sturgeon-like body, including a bony ridge on its top. With front flippers and no back limbs, it swims like a dolphin and has a crocodile-like snout

claims.statement: In the summer of 1980, two men reportedly saw Altamaha-ha stranded on a mud bank near Cathead Creek; they reported the animal lying halfway in the water, thrashing and trying to free itself from the bank.
claims.statement_id: Pada musim panas 1980, dua pria dilaporkan melihat Altamaha-ha terdampar di gundukan lumpur dekat Cathead Creek; menurut mereka hewan itu setengah terendam dalam air, menggelepar dan berusaha melepaskan diri dari tepian.
claims.quote: In the summer of 1980, two men reportedly saw Altamaha-ha stranded on a mud bank near Cathead Creek. They reported that the animal was lying halfway in the water, thrashing and trying to free itself from the bank.

claims.statement: Though no physical evidence has been found, the tales date back centuries, with the Indians describing a giant snake-like creature that hissed and bellowed.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun belum ditemukan bukti fisik, kisahnya berusia berabad-abad, dengan orang Indian menggambarkan makhluk raksasa mirip ular yang mendesis dan menggeram.
claims.quote: Though no physical evidence of the Altamaha-ha has been found, the tales date back centuries, with the Indians describing a giant snake-like creature that hissed and bellowed.

claims.statement: A notable instance of the British big cat phenomenon is the "Beast of Exmoor", sometimes called the "Exmoor Beast".
claims.statement_id: Salah satu contoh menonjol fenomena kucing besar Inggris adalah "Beast of Exmoor", kadang disebut "Exmoor Beast".
